title: Odoo Quote-to-Cash Airlock
desc: Turns one inbound order request into a confirmed Odoo sales order, a posted customer invoice, and an optional reconciled payment — with the customer-exists branch and two amount-drift guards in between.
description: Takes a single inbound order request and drives it end to end through Odoo: normalise and validate the payload, look the customer up by email, create the customer only when the lookup misses, draft a quotation, confirm it into a sales order, draft the customer invoice, post it to the ledger, and register a reconciled payment when the order is marked prepaid. Every ledger-touching step runs through the airlock as preview -> approve -> execute, so an operator sees the exact record and total before it fires. The two irreversible money steps carry expected_amount_total, which the odoo module verifies against the live record and refuses when they disagree, closing the gap where a quote is edited between approval and execution. Version 1.1.0 adds a thirteen-node engine_spec so the run executes on the DAG engine: nodes carry parent and branch across four lanes (intake, order, billing, settlement) instead of edges, and every effect declares provider odoo. The six transforms were rewritten to pass the engine transform gate, which allowlists AST nodes and permits neither try nor raise: numeric coercion is now a pure type check plus a regex on strings, and a validation failure emits ok=false with a problems list rather than throwing. Each effect carries a cond reading that flag, so a bad order stops before Odoo instead of raising mid-run - create_customer fires only when the email lookup missed, settle only when the order is prepaid and the posted invoice still has a residual. Both for_each nodes declare for_each_max_size 1, because each list is zero-or-one by construction, so the planner can bound the spend instead of escalating on an unknown count. The thirteen-node canvas is retained for display and now carries the same node code, so the two representations cannot drift. module_dependency pins ray9/odoo at minimum_version 1.2.0 - every effect resolves to a command that module signs, and none of them run without it.

args.note: Drafted by the RailCall Odoo Quote-to-Cash Airlock. Confirm, invoice and payment each require their own approval.

nodes.code:
confirmed = input.get("confirmed") or {}
resolved = input.get("resolved") or {}

so_name = str(confirmed.get("order_name") or "").strip()
state = str(confirmed.get("state") or "")
problems = list(resolved.get("problems") or [])

if state not in ("sale", "done"):
    problems.append("refusing to invoice: sales order " + (so_name or "?") + " is in state '" + state + "', not confirmed")

partner_id = resolved.get("partner_id")
if not isinstance(partner_id, int) or isinstance(partner_id, bool) or partner_id <= 0:
    partner_id = 0
    problems.append("no partner_id to invoice")

billed = []
for ln in (resolved.get("lines") or []):
    entry = dict(ln)
    label = str(entry.get("name") or "").strip()
    entry["name"] = (label + " [" + so_name + "]") if so_name else label
    billed.append(entry)

if not billed:
    problems.append("confirmed order " + (so_name or "?") + " produced no billable lines")

output = {
    "ok": not problems,
    "problems": problems,
    "partner_id": partner_id,
    "lines": billed,
    "source_order": so_name,
    "confirmed_total": confirmed.get("amount_total", 0),
    "line_count": len(billed),
}

args.narration: Invoice raised against confirmed sales order {{nodes.invoice_basis.source_order}} by the RailCall Quote-to-Cash Airlock.
